stage0046b_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ラム$$
「The Element kids...
　they still haven't gotten over
　losing $$ジン$$, it seems」

stage0046b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ members
　have plenty of experience by now.
　They're trying to handle it themselves」

stage0046b_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Seems like they're processing it
　inside themselves, from past experience」

stage0046b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ボビー$$
「In $n's case,
　he lost family outside of battle,
　so the wound might run deeper」

stage0046b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In $F's case,
　I don't think that's all there is to it...」

stage0046b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lieutenant $$キャシー$$... show me the data
　on him again」

stage0046b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$キャシー$$
「About the accident with his father and sister?」

stage0046b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Machine group approaching, confirmed!
　This is... UG!」

stage0046b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$キャシー$$
「It seems the UG has designated us
　as their attack target!」

stage0046b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units!
　We intercept them!」

stage0046b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「That unit hasn't shown up yet...」

stage0046b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$アマタ$$ and the others, and $n,
　are still underground! We'll handle this!」

stage0046b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Coming at us head-on... seems
　these guys mean business too!」

stage0046b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Good chance! Take down the manned units
　and make them spill their goal!」

stage0046b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Big talk... but that will
　turn to despair soon enough」

stage0046b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「By my own hand!」

stage0046b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$アマタ$$ and the others still aren't here!?」

stage0046b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I just... feel like I might never
　see $$アマタ$$ and the others again...」

stage0046b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hey, you!
　Don't say something so ominous!」

stage0046b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Well done.
　No wonder, coming from a $$烙印$$-bearer」

stage0046b_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Not good, honey.
　You gotta tell me before you sortie」

stage0046b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Shut up! This is all because
　of you...!」

stage0046b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's the mountain behind that academy」

stage0046b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The Imitation's there.
　I'll leave the cleanup to you, honey」

stage0046b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Understood!
　I'll burn the whole area, him included!」

stage0046b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カレン$$
「That woman...! She's heading
　for $$聖天使学園$$!?」

stage0046b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Just his existence alone...!
　The one who wounded our last pride,
　him I will never forgive!!」

stage0046b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You'd get in my way, artificial human!」

stage0046b_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What are you doing!?
　Why aren't you raising your A.T. Field!?」

stage0046b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't know, but I felt like
　I shouldn't raise my A.T. Field!」

stage0046b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I feel $$アマタ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ more strongly than before!」

stage0046b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So this is $$ミコノ$$'s power to connect...!」

stage0046b_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you...!
　I understand now, thanks to you!」

stage0046b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「The bond between $$ジン$$ and you showed
　what connecting to $$ミコノ$$ means」

stage0046b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　With this, we can use our Element
　abilities directly!」

stage0046b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「My power to connect and $$ゼシカ$$'s
　power to twist...! Use it, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0046b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I feel $$アマタ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ more strongly than before!」

stage0046b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So this is $$ミコノ$$'s power to connect...!」

stage0046b_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　With this, we can use our Element
　abilities directly!」

stage0046b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「My power to connect and $$ゼシカ$$'s
　power to twist...! Use it, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0046b_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So you came out, Imitation!
　Now my sortie has meaning!」

stage0046b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Come! I'll settle this!」

stage0046b_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Everyone's hearts are connected...!
　I'm... not alone!）

stage0046b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$n
（My life has meaning too...!
　Even me, powerless, who lost father and sister...!）

stage0046b_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Watch...!
　I will protect the pride of G!!」

stage0046b_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That was some enemy we didn't understand」

stage0046b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シュレード$$
「You can tell, best friend?」

stage0046b_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Climbing out of a hole feels nice」

stage0046b_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's 'cause there was a hole in the first place」

stage0046b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Sometimes we rot away, too...」

stage0046b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You're okay now, right, $$ユノハ$$?」

stage0046b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Seems like the Elements have moved on」

stage0046b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Reborn... that might be
　the fitting way to put it」

stage0046b_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（We'll do our best.
　So... someday, let's meet again...）

stage0046b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If you think that's enough
　to beat me, you're dead wrong!」

stage0046b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$n
「Big talk, but I can see you're rattled...!」

stage0046b_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$n
「If you were really strong, you wouldn't
　need big talk to take down someone like me」

stage0046b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$n
「Seems I hit the mark.
　Your temper's the best proof of that...!」

stage0046b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$n
「Come, UG! Today, you're telling me
　what your goal is!」

stage0046b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s power to connect!」

stage0046b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s consciousness and mine... become one!」

stage0046b_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Be careful, $n! Your energy's
　dropping fast!」

stage0046b_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In this mode, we can only fight
　for about two minutes!」

stage0046b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$n
「That's enough! I'll settle this
　before then!」

stage0046b_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But this might tell us the activation conditions...」

stage0046b_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$n
「That's a story for after we get back alive...!」

stage0046b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$スズネ$$
（What's this... my body's so hot...）

stage0046b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Guh...! This is as far as
　the $$アンゲロイ$$ can go!」

stage0046b_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「This isn't running away!
　This is a strategic retreat!」

stage0046b_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「You attack us without even giving
　your name, and you talk so big!」

stage0046b_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...I'm $$アンナロッタ$$...」

stage0046b_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$!
　That's my name!」

stage0046b_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Next time, I stake my pride on it,
　and I will wipe you all out!
　Don't forget my name till then!」

stage0046b_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$n
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$...」

stage0046b_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's the name of UG's commander...」

stage0046b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$n
「Someone's here, in a place like this!?」

stage0046b_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「I'm out of luck too!
　I came to collect in famous $$アクエリア市$$,
　and got caught up in a battle!」

stage0046b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「My creed's to never break the law,
　yet this world's got no god or buddha!」

stage0046b_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$n
「If you have time to complain,
　just hurry up and run!」

stage0046b_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「...Now that I think about it,
　something like this happened before...
　I can't quite recall it, though...」

stage0046b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry about that, bro!
　Take this as an apology for the trouble!
　Keep it!」

stage0046b_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「I got it in place of loan interest.
　Don't worry about it.」

stage0046b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「That's right!
　This here $$ゼニトリー・マッセ$$...
　hard at work, clean and honest, as always!」

stage0046b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シンジ$$
（$$ジン$$...
　I don't know what I can do from here on, but...）

stage0046b_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I will pilot EVA...
　and think about the meaning of life you taught me）

stage0046b_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アマタ$$
「My body feels so light...!
　I really feel reborn!」

stage0046b_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right, $$アマタ・ソラ$$!
　Your wings hold the power to surpass
　everything... even fate itself!」

stage0046b_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「With this, I can fly anywhere!
　With my new wings!!」

stage0046b_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I won't be lost to despair anymore...!
　Whatever the future holds,
　I'll fight to overcome it!」

stage0046b_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right, $$カイエン・スズシロ$$!
　See beyond despair!
　That is your fight!」

stage0046b_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「My power to connect...!
　It unites hearts, wishes and feelings as one!」

stage0046b_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$不動$$
（Nothing changes...
　whether 12,000 years pass, or 24,000...）

stage0046b_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$モロイ$$
「I faced my own fragile heart!
　And I overcame it!」

stage0046b_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right, $$モロイ・ドレッツァ$$!
　Now, show your enemy that strong heart of yours!」

stage0046b_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I won't hesitate anymore!
　I'll dig, and dig, and keep digging!」

stage0046b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$不動$$
「As the masters say, dig your own grave,
　but break clean through, and I've won...」

stage0046b_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$不動$$
「Master it, $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$...!
　Your path of digging!」

stage0046b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I will live...!
　With someone precious... someone I love!」

stage0046b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$不動$$
（Infatuation becomes love, love becomes grief...
　what waits beyond that, $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$?）

stage0046b_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$シュレード$$
「In the pitch darkness, it became clear.
　That I still can't die.」

stage0046b_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$シュレード$$
「The ultimate melody...!
　Don't run out before I find it, my life!」

stage0046b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$不動$$
（That's right, $$シュレード・エラン$$...
　What you seek lies beyond despair）

stage0046b_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
（Even a dark hole, if it's one $$アンディ$$ dug,
　felt precious to me...）

stage0046b_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh... has the hole in your heart been filled, $$ＭＩＸ$$?」

stage0046b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「F-$$不動$$, Supreme Commander!
　Don't peek into people's hearts without permission!」

stage0046b_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Even fallen, I'm still an Element!
　Here I go!」

stage0046b_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right, $$サザンカ・ビアンカ$$...!
　Unleash your own desires!」

stage0046b_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Alright then!
　No holding back, here I goooo!!」

stage0046b_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（$$ジン$$...
　It's still sad, but I'll look ahead...）

stage0046b_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（The meaning of life $$ジン$$ taught me...
　it's here in my heart, so...!）

stage0046b_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「So I won't cry anymore!
　That's how I won't forget $$ジン$$!」

stage0046b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$n
「How dare you target Miss $$スズネ$$ just now!」

stage0046b_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Such an act was not my intent...!
　But we have a reason
　we must do so!」

stage0046b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$n
「A pathetic excuse.
　Worse than brazening it out.」

stage0046b_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You...!
　I won't let you defile the pride of G any further!」

stage0046b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$n
「Someone who'd attack an unarmed person
　has no right to talk about pride!
　Get that through your head, you rotten scum!」
